name: @gugacarbo/skill-casa-standard
description: Development tooling for the casa-standard skill.

scripts.validate: bun run test && bun run build && bun -e "await Bun.file('evals/evals.json').json()"
scripts.build: bash -lc 'tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$tmp\"" EXIT; bun build --target=bun evals/run-evals.mjs --outfile "$tmp/run-evals.mjs"'
